name: Machine Gun 10k (code)
description: The M-1000 Maxigun's backpack holds 10,000 rounds, written as a code mod against the HellForge mod SDK: it widens the engine's deposit_value network field from 10 to 14 bits (which no Lua mod can) and sets the backpack's capacity, starting ammo and resupply through named fields (SDK 6). Source in src/.
